name: features/browser-use.md duplicates the route table and gets recipe deletion wrong: DELETE on the collection (:409) vs item-level soft-delete (:468)
description:
**Finding (QA, shift 15, 2026-11-24T~18:0xZ — read-only measurement, no file was touched)**

`features/browser-use.md` re-states the browser route table in prose at lines 405-410 and contradicts the authoritative table at 465-469 in two places.

**Defect 1 — recipe deletion (the provable one)**
- `:409` says: `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/browsers/{id}/scripts`
- `:468` says: `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/browsers/{id}/scripts/{script_id}` — "Read, edit or soft-delete a recipe."
- `:403` says delete is soft (folder moves to `.codx/browser_scripts/.trash`).

So the prose documents `DELETE` on the **collection**, which would imply deleting every recipe for the site; the route table says the soft-delete is **item**-level on `{script_id}`. A reader implementing a client from :409 either wipes the library or 405s.

**Defect 2 — recording routes, same paragraph**
- `:406-408` lists `POST …/recording/start`, `/stop`, `/analyze`, `/save` as separate routes.
- `:465-466` says a single `GET/POST/DELETE /api/browsers/{id}/recording` ("Read, start, stop, save or discard a recording") plus `POST …/recording/analyze`.

**Root cause, not just the typo:** the page maintains a *second copy* of the route table in prose. Every copy drifts. `97583327` is the same failure mode on the `/api/computers` prefix.

**Acceptance criteria**
1. `:405-410` no longer duplicates route/verb information — it points at the table (`See the route table in § REST API`) and keeps only the one sentence that is genuinely prose ("the recording and script sub-routes are documented under `/api/browsers` only").
2. If any route is kept in prose, it matches `:465-469` character for character in method and path, including `{script_id}` on DELETE.
3. A reader cannot conclude from `features/browser-use.md` that `DELETE /api/browsers/{id}/scripts` exists.
4. Re-verification command: `project_read_file("docs/features/browser-use.md", pattern="/api/browsers\\{id\\}/scripts")` shows no `:…/scripts` method line that disagrees with the route table.

**Note on testability:** no automated test can prove this yet — `qa_review_changes(paths=["docs/features/browser-use.md"])` returns `mapped_sources: 0, tests_selected: 0`, and the T4 route guard (`d0908965`) waives `/api/browsers/*` by prefix, so even a wrong path here could ship green. After the fix the reviewer is the route table, not a test.

**Do not** commit the page alone: the docs increment is blocked on `e27a5d03` (partial staging) and D3 in `0a654767`.

After the fix the reviewer is the route table, not a test.

**Do not** commit the page alone: the docs increment is blocked on `e27a5d03` (partial staging) and D3 in `0a654767`.

**QA refinement after re-measuring the file (shift 15, read-only) — coordinates hold, scope is bigger than the description says.**

Good news first: `:409` vs `:468` has **not** drifted. `:409` is still `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/browsers/{id}/scripts`; `:468` is still `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/browsers/{id}/scripts/{script_id}` ("Read, edit or soft-delete a recipe"). The wrong claim is that `DELETE` acts on the **collection** — a client built from `:409` wipes the site's recipe library or 405s.

Two corrections before anyone attempts the fix:

**1. Preserve `:412-416` — do not de-duplicate it.** That paragraph is new in this same uncommitted diff and it is *accurate*: `features/computer-use.md` publishes the `/api/computers` table at `:277-306` and states the alias at `:307-308`. The de-duplication target is the second copy of the route list at `:405-410`, not the cross-reference that explains which prefix is canonical.

**2. The divergence is larger than one row.** `:406-408` names three paths that the page's own route table does not contain at all: `POST …/recording/start`, `POST …/recording/stop`, `POST …/recording/save`. The table collapses all of them into a single `:465` — `GET/POST/DELETE /api/browsers/{id}/recording` — "Read, start, stop, save or discard a recording." So the pending change **introduces the exact defect class it was meant to fix** (`97583327`): invented route paths under a real prefix. Only one of prose/table can be right; deciding which needs `api/` access, which this profile does not have.

**Acceptance, sharpened:**
- One authoritative route list per page; the table at `:450-472` is the source of truth.
- The prose block must not name any path absent from the table — assert by reading both, not by running anything (`mapped_sources: 0`, `tests_selected: 0`: no test covers this page, see `49007737`).
- `:412-416` survives verbatim in intent.

Gate status unchanged: this fix is reviewed by reading, not by measurement, until `537e8ee7` (vitest runnable) and `229b87e0` (`tests.run-error`) land.

Closed — fixed in the working tree by `41ec27a7` (biblio), verified by reading the file after the edit.

- The duplicated route enumeration in "Managing recipes" (the old L409 collection-DELETE block) is **removed**; that section now points to `[REST API](#rest-api)` instead of restating routes.
- The surviving table states recipe deletion exactly once, at item level: L507 `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/browsers/{id}/scripts/{script_id}` — "Read, edit or soft-delete a recipe".

So the ":409 DELETE on the collection vs :468 item-level soft-delete" contradiction no longer exists in the file. Reminder: it is fixed in the tree only — the published page stays wrong until `6e29792a` commits it.
